# Hobo Livings (hoboliving.in)
> Verified Student Hostels, PGs & Co-Living Spaces in Greater Noida & Noida with ₹0 Brokerage Guarantee.

## Overview
Hobo Livings (Hobo Livings Private Limited) is a DPIIT-recognized PropTech startup (Cert: DIPP104245, #startupindia) helping university students and working professionals find safe, fully-furnished, verified hostels, PGs, and shared co-living spaces across Greater Noida, Noida, and Delhi NCR.

- **Primary Website:** https://www.hoboliving.in
- **Zero Brokerage Guarantee:** 100% free for students and tenants (₹0 commission).
- **Physical Assisted Visits:** Free guided tours with Instant Digital Visit Passes.
- **Bed Hold:** 48-hour zero-cost bed reservation lock.
- **Price Range:** ₹7,500 to ₹25,000 / month (inclusive of 3 fresh meals, AC, high-speed Wi-Fi, biometric security, and power backup).

## Major Campus Hubs & Localities
- [GL Bajaj Institute of Technology & Management](https://www.hoboliving.in/campuses/gl-bajaj-greater-noida): Hostels & PGs in Knowledge Park II & III.
- [Galgotias University & College](https://www.hoboliving.in/campuses/galgotias-university-greater-noida): Accommodations near Yamuna Expressway & Knowledge Park.
- [Sharda University](https://www.hoboliving.in/campuses/sharda-university-greater-noida): Verified boys and girls PGs near Knowledge Park III.
- [Amity University Noida](https://www.hoboliving.in/campuses/amity-university-noida): Student accommodations near Sector 125 & Expressway.
- [JSS Academy / Sector 62 Noida](https://www.hoboliving.in/campuses/jss-academy-sector-62-noida): IT hub & student housing.
- [NIET & Lloyd Institute](https://www.hoboliving.in/campuses/niet-greater-noida): Safe hostel clusters with mess facilities.
- [Pari Chowk & Alpha 1](https://www.hoboliving.in/campuses/pari-chowk-greater-noida): Metro-connected student PGs.

## Authoritative Student Guides (2026 Edition)
- [Complete Student Housing Guide 2026](https://www.hoboliving.in/guides/student-housing-guide): Step-by-step checklist on finding verified hostels in Greater Noida.
- [Hostel vs PG Cost Breakdown](https://www.hoboliving.in/guides/hostel-vs-pg-cost-breakdown): Complete comparison of security deposits, electricity charges, and food expenses.
- [Hostel Mess vs Tiffin Service Guide](https://www.hoboliving.in/guides/hostel-mess-vs-tiffin-food-guide): Menu variety, hygiene, and daily nutritional analysis.

## Key Amenities Standardized Across Accommodations
- 3 Fresh Hygienic Meals Daily + Evening Tea / Snacks
- High-Speed Fiber Internet & Study Desks
- Split / Window Air Conditioning (AC)
- 24/7 CCTV & Biometric Turnstile Security
- Daily Housekeeping & Professional Laundry
- 100% Electricity Power Backup (Inverters & Generators)
